$description: Delta 2027 design tokens, DTCG 2025.10. CSS-only output recipes are not part of this exchange.

blue-900.$description: UNDRR corporate blue. Also DELTA's brand blue: DELTA's own design file labels this swatch "UNDRR Blue - Corporate blue" and marks it Brand.

button-primary.$description: Stroke on filled primary buttons. The fill is painted under the border, so `transparent` makes the stroke match the fill and keeps filled and outline buttons the same size. A theme can set a colour here (for example a darker shade of the fill) to give filled buttons a visible edge.

button-secondary.$description: Stroke on filled secondary buttons. See border-color.button-primary.

lg.$description: card padding, section gaps, tablet/desktop margin

fast.$description: tooltips, hover states, focus rings - pre-wired in components, do not use in feature code

normal.$description: dropdowns, modals, toasts - pre-wired in components, do not use in feature code

slow.$description: page transitions, large panels - pre-wired in components, do not use in feature code

default.$description: all transitions - fast out, slow to settle

background.$description: Background of book and horizontal book publication teasers.

padding.$description: Outer publication teaser inset; cover-to-caption gaps are separate.

border-radius.$description: Outer publication surface radius; complete cover artwork remains square.

shadow-hover.$description: Linked publication surface elevation on hover.

font-size.$description: Dates, attribution and supporting metadata in content teasers and cards; summaries retain body size.

background.$description: Content teaser surface, defaulting to the standard card background independently of publication surfaces.

padding.$description: Content inset and complete-cover/logo inset inside the enclosed horizontal teaser; photographs meet the outer edge.

border-radius.$description: Content teaser enclosure radius, defaulting to the standard card radius.

shadow.$description: Content teaser soft enclosure, defaulting to the standard card surface at rest.

shadow-hover.$description: Content teaser soft enclosure on hover, defaulting to the standard card hover surface.

title-font-size.$description: Title size in vertical content card layouts.

book-title-font-size.$description: Title size in book card layouts.

background.$description: Independent content-card surface; publication surfaces do not determine this value.

padding.$description: Independent content-card surface; publication surfaces do not determine this value.

border-radius.$description: Independent content-card surface; publication surfaces do not determine this value.

shadow.$description: Independent content-card surface; publication surfaces do not determine this value.

shadow-hover.$description: Independent content-card surface; publication surfaces do not determine this value.

book-cover-height.$description: Desktop search book-grid media stage; missing media reserves this space only in multi-column layouts.

default.$description: #FAF9F5 - page background (warm). White surfaces sit on it

inset.$description: hover state on rows / list items, current nav item

disabled.$description: Disabled control fill (decoupled from row-hover inset).

toast.$description: Adapter role from the handoff toast and tooltip specifications.

control.$description: Inputs, selects, secondary buttons. 3.36:1 on white, 3.19:1 on page (WCAG 1.4.11). Hover: text.secondary. Cards and dividers keep default/subtle. Agreed 2026-11-09.

primary.$description: 17.50:1 on page, 18.43:1 on white - body text, headings

secondary.$description: 6.26:1 on page, 6.59:1 on white - supporting text, labels

disabled.$description: 2.52:1 on white, 2.39:1 on page — disabled / decorative ONLY, never informational text or input placeholders (renamed from v0.7.2 semantic.text.placeholder).

default.$description: 5.37:1 on white, 5.09:1 on page - interactive elements, links

selected.$description: Adapter role from the handoff table and tree selected-state specifications.

ringInverse.$description: Keyboard focus indicator on dark surfaces.

targetMin.$description: Smallest clickable area, width and height (WCAG 2.5.8). Icon buttons are 32px. A smaller visual, for example a 16px checkbox, gets its size from padding or its label.
